description: Evidence-grounded retrospective of a Codex or Claude Code session, or an explicit group of sessions. Use for /session-review, retrospective, rétrospective, post-mortem, retour d'expérience, or an assessment of how a session went. Inspects real traces. Not a code review or design review.

claude-home.reason: The skill reviews Claude Code sessions too, so the Codex text, evals and analyzer must name where Claude Code keeps its transcripts (~/.claude/projects/), subagent definitions (.claude/agents/) and rules (.claude/rules/).
